column1: # The marks the findings karyogram (core.js karyogram(), person.js Figure 1) drew on the demo's person pages,
# recorded before the genome map replaced it: one row per mark, from each page at the end of its run. A mark is a
# finding with a viewer place (chrN:pos or chrN:start-end) that the page did not keep closed (DEMO-003 is a child,
# so its results to act on and the findings tagged with them were not drawn). mb is the place's first
# position in Mb, rounded to 0.01. tests/test_live_demo.py checks the map places each one.
